messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · MO01 is past its stamped date with no stock and no new date to give

Sorry about this one, nothing has shipped yet and it should have.

Your order has four lines. The M. MO01 and the Helium Mobile WiFi hotspot were due to go out September 25, so they're behind. The Miner Duster ships October 15 and travels separately. The Harlo OS diagnostics is a service, nothing to ship.

I'm getting the current warehouse date for the MO01 confirmed now, and the team has been pinged on it. Stay in the chat and they'll jump in here, or it comes to your email.
Before you go, one thing: what made the MO01 the one you picked?
wanted a desktop ticker. and to throw a solo miner into one of my pools

Makes sense, and it'll pool fine, Harlo OS takes a stratum URL, worker and password in settings.

Which pool are you pointing it at?
Got it. Was there another unit you nearly went with instead?
high power cap····an ROI limit is what i look at.

Understood, that's useful, thank you. I'll pass it on with the rest.

The date on the MO01 is with the team now, and they'll come back in here or by email.
Noted, they'll write to (email hidden) with the MO01 date. A copy of this whole chat comes to that address too once we're done here, and you can reply to it to reach us again.
Ha, here's hoping. Take care, and watch your inbox for that date.
I'm Sarah, the team's automated first line here on the chat. Abel or Georges step in when something needs a person, which is what's happening with your MO01 date.
Thanks, I'll take it. Anything else you want sorted while you're here?
All good then. The team will email you the MO01 date, and your Duster is set for October 15. Happy mining.
